title: Bramble and Starry's Light Path
markdown:
The sun starts to yawn. Its golden rays get shorter each day. It’s time to go home. The trees remember this. They whisper as the sky gets dark.

Once upon a time, Bramble the bunny lived in a green meadow. Bramble had soft, brown fur. His whiskers wiggled when he found something new. Starry the teddy bear was his best friend. Starry was yellow and soft like a cloud. His button eyes sparkled.

Every day, Bramble and Starry played. Bramble hopped fast after butterflies. Their wings were like little painted sails. Starry watched them with his big, kind eyes. When they were tired, they had pretend tea parties. They used pretend cups. They sipped pretend tea made of dandelion puffs. The puffs tickled their noses. They giggled and giggled.

Until one day. The very last butterfly flew away. It had bright blue wings. It went over the tall grass and into the big sky. The meadow turned a soft purple, like a sleepy hug. It was quiet. The crickets started to sing their soft night song.

Bramble’s whiskers drooped a little. He looked around. The meadow was big. The light was going away fast. Bramble didn’t know where to hop. It felt new and quiet. He wiggled his nose. It didn’t feel like playtime anymore.

Starry snuggled close. Starry always listened with his fluffy ears. His button eyes looked at Bramble. He gave Bramble a warm, soft squeeze. It was a hug that said, “I am here with you.”

Then, something surprising happened. Near Bramble’s soft paws, little lights started to glow. They were not bright lights. They were gentle lights, like tiny stars saying hello from the grass. They blinked on, one by one. They made a soft, friendly path. Whoooo could have guessed? The lights seemed to say, “Come this way, little friends. We know a safe place.”

Bramble’s ears perked up. He nudged Starry. Together, they followed the blinking lights. The lights danced past the sleepy buttercups. They went around the rustling ferns. The little lights were slow and kind. They were like friendly fireflies. The air smelled sweet, like dirt after rain and flowers that bloom at night.

Until finally, the little lights led them to a big log. It was covered in soft moss. It looked like a friendly giant. Around the log were other friends. Finley the field mouse was tucked in a soft bed of leaves. Pip the robin tucked his head under his wing on a twig. Everyone was quiet and still. They breathed softly. The log felt warm and safe. The air smelled very sweet, like moss and honey flowers.

Ever since then, Bramble and Starry knew that even when the sun went down, there were new, gentle adventures. Sometimes, these adventures led them to cozy, safe places. Little blinking lights showed them the way. And that, dear listener, is a wonderful thing. Whoooo knew the end of the day could be so special?
characters: Bramble the bunny, Starry the teddy
